_comment: The placement engine's tuning, as a tracked artifact — edited from the Engine panel of `make place` (hardware/layout_poc/web/), which writes this file on every change. Keys are the engine's parameter names (engines/d3force.mjs reads the same names from the environment), so one tuning serves both. Values below are the PoC's current config. Delete a key to fall back to the built-in default; `order` is the panel's row order and is absent while it is the default.
